## Scope

The `src/app` folder is the Conduit (RealWorld) Angular single-page application. It contains the root shell (`AppComponent`), routing in `app.routes.ts`, bootstrap and HTTP wiring in `app.config.ts`, `core/` (auth, interceptors, layout, models), `features/` (article, profile, settings), and `shared/` (components and pipes). The SPA must match routes, DOM selectors, `localStorage` key `jwtToken`, and `window.__conduit_debug__` from `realworld/specs/e2e/SELECTORS.md`. Relative URLs are prefixed with `https://api.realworld.show/api` in `core/interceptors/api.interceptor.ts`. Parent map under `src/`: [../AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).

## Components

| Component | Path | Responsibility | Detail |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| core/auth | `core/auth` | Login and register UI, `JwtService`, `UserService`, auth guards | [core/AGENTS.md](core/AGENTS.md) |
| core/interceptors | `core/interceptors` | API base URL, `Token` header, global error and 401 handling | [core/AGENTS.md](core/AGENTS.md) |
| core/layout | `core/layout` | `nav.navbar` header and footer shell | [core/AGENTS.md](core/AGENTS.md) |
| core/models | `core/models` | `Errors`, `LoadingState` shared types | [core/AGENTS.md](core/AGENTS.md) |
| features/article | `features/article` | Home feed, tag filter, editor, article detail | [features/AGENTS.md](features/AGENTS.md) |
| features/profile | `features/profile` | `/profile/:username` and favorites child routes | [features/AGENTS.md](features/AGENTS.md) |
| features/settings | `features/settings` | `PUT /user`, logout, settings form fields | [features/AGENTS.md](features/AGENTS.md) |
| shared/components | `shared/components` | `app-list-errors` → `.error-messages` | — |
| shared/pipes | `shared/pipes` | `defaultImage` for null profile images | — |

**Core** owns cross-cutting auth, HTTP, layout, and shared types. **Features** own route-aligned product areas (article feed/editor/detail, profile tabs, settings). **Shared** supplies reusable UI and pipes imported by core and features.

## Routing and feature ownership

`app.routes.ts` defines lazy-loaded routes and guards:

| Route | Owner | Guard |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `''`, `tag/:tag` | `features/article` (home) | — |
| `login`, `register` | `core/auth` | Guest only (authenticated users redirected) |
| `settings` | `features/settings` | `requireAuth` |
| `editor`, `editor/:slug` | `features/article` | `requireAuth` |
| `profile` (lazy) | `features/profile` | — |
| `article/:slug` | `features/article` | — |

Shell order in `app.component.html`: `app-layout-header`, `router-outlet`, `app-layout-footer`.

## Rules that apply

Follow [../../RULES.md](../../RULES.md): harness-only agent edits, no secrets, match existing Angular and TypeScript conventions. Use standalone components, `OnPush`, and lazy `loadComponent` where routes already do. Align CSS classes and form `name` attributes with `realworld/specs/e2e/SELECTORS.md`. Domain terms: [../../DOMAIN.md](../../DOMAIN.md). Repository entry: [../../AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md).

## Local conventions

- **Shell**: `app-layout-header`, `router-outlet`, `app-layout-footer` in `app.component.html`.
- **Token**: `JwtService` reads and writes `localStorage['jwtToken']`; `tokenInterceptor` sends `Authorization: Token <jwt>`.
- **Debug**: `app.config.ts` sets `window.__conduit_debug__` (`getToken`, `getAuthState`, `getCurrentUser`) for Playwright when `BROWSER_API` is enabled.
- **Auth startup**: `initAuth` calls `GET /user` when a token exists; 4XX purges auth; 5XX enters `unavailable` with retry per `UserService`.
- **Errors**: Validation errors render via `app-list-errors` as `.error-messages`; non-bootstrap 401 is handled through `errorInterceptor` and `purgeAuth()`.
- **Null images**: Header and profile UI use `defaultImage` pipe — align with null-field E2E expectations.

System behavior and data flow: [../../ARCHITECTURE.md](../../ARCHITECTURE.md).
